faq.title: Questions, answered
faq.subtitle: Still curious? Reach out any time — a real human will reply.

compliant.a: Yes. Complyr is built specifically for GDPR and ePrivacy compliance. We store consent logs as audit-ready evidence — 12 months on Starter, up to 3 years on Pro and Business — support granular per-category consent, and generate compliant cookie policies automatically. Your visitors' data is hosted entirely within the EU.

different.q: How is Complyr different from Cookiebot or Osano?
different.a: Two words: simplicity and price. Enterprise tools charge €50–500+/month and take training to use. Complyr does 95% of what they do, for a fraction of the price, with an interface you'll understand in 30 seconds.

analytics.q: Do I need this if I only use Google Analytics?
analytics.a: Yes. If your site uses Google Analytics, Facebook Pixel, YouTube embeds, or any tracking cookie, EU law requires prior consent. Complyr handles this properly, with Google Consent Mode v2 built in.

consentMode.q: What is Google Consent Mode v2?
consentMode.a: It's Google's system for respecting user consent while still enabling analytics. Since March 2024 it's mandatory for Google Ads users in the EU. Complyr sets it up automatically — defaulting every signal to 'denied' until your visitor chooses.

dataLocation.a: All visitor and consent data is stored in EU data centres in Germany. We use EU-based infrastructure exclusively — no US data transfer, no Schrems II headache.

cancel.a: Yes. Cancel with one click — no contracts, no cancellation fees, no hoops. You keep access until the end of your billing period.

platforms.q: Does it work with WordPress, Shopify, Wix, etc.?
platforms.a: Yes. Complyr works on any website — just paste one line of code before your closing head tag. A dedicated WordPress plugin is on the way.

freePlan.q: Do you offer a free plan?
freePlan.a: We offer a 14-day free trial — no credit card, up to 1,000 consent events. After the trial, pick a plan from €9/month to keep your banner live; until you do, new scans and adding sites are paused, though your consent log is never deleted. We keep prices low so we can invest in the product instead of subsidising a permanent free tier.

finalCta.title: Ready to stop worrying about cookie consent?
finalCta.subtitle: Set up Complyr in minutes. 14-day free trial, no credit card required.

delete.keptBody: Consent records are your visitors' evidence, not your data, and the law requires them to stay tamper-proof. Sites that recorded consent stay behind as an empty placeholder — no domain, no key, nothing linking them to you — until those records expire and are deleted automatically after three years.
delete.irreversible: This cannot be undone. Export your data first if you want to keep a copy.
delete.confirmDescription: Enter your password to confirm. Your account and its data are erased immediately.

done.title: Your account has been deleted
done.description: You have been signed out. Nothing links this browser to the account any more.
done.sitesDeleted: {count, plural, =0 {No site was deleted} one {# site was deleted completely} other {# sites were deleted completely}}
done.sitesAnonymized: {count, plural, =0 {No site had to be kept} one {# site was kept as an anonymous placeholder for visitor consent records} other {# sites were kept as anonymous placeholders for visitor consent records}}
